_comment: Example hardware profile for the 7-tier cache-bounding methodology. Copy this file, list every device you want tier boundaries derived from, and pass it to compute_cache_tier_sizes.py --devices <file>. Sizes are aggregate device cache capacities in bytes ('null' if a level doesn't apply, e.g. GPUs with no traditional L2/LLC split). Add or remove as many devices as you like -- tier targets are always derived from the min/max across whatever is listed here.
